test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following characteristics is true about the Northern Plains?

options.text: Densely populated due to fertile soil
Low fertility due to rocky terrain

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Densely populated due to fertile soil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Northern Plains** are one of the most densely populated regions in India due to the presence of **fertile soil**, which supports agriculture extensively.
 
• They are formed by the deposits of **alluvial soil** brought by rivers like the **Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Indus**, making the region highly productive for crops such as wheat, rice, and sugarcane.
 
• The plains span across northern India, covering states like **Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal**.
 
• These plains have a flat terrain, which makes irrigation and farming convenient and supports the growth of major agricultural industries.
 
• The presence of rivers ensures an abundance of **water resources**, further contributing to agricultural output and settlement growth.
 
• The region has a favorable climate, with ample rainfall during the monsoon season, supporting both **Kharif and Rabi crops**.
 
• Due to the fertile soil and agricultural opportunities, the Northern Plains have become a hub of population concentration and urbanization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Presence of volcanic plateaus**__

 __
 
• The volcanic plateaus are formed due to **volcanic activities** and are typically found in regions like the **Deccan Plateau** in India.
 
• These areas are characterized by **volcanic rocks** and are not related to the Northern Plains, which are formed by alluvial deposits.
 
 
 
• **High elevation with steep slopes**__
 __
 
• High elevations with steep slopes are characteristic of **mountainous regions** such as the Himalayas, not the flat terrain of the Northern Plains.
 
• The Northern Plains have a **low elevation**, making them ideal for agriculture and settlement rather than steep slopes.
 
 
 
• **Low fertility due to rocky terrain**__
 
 
• Rocky terrains are found in regions like the **Western Ghats** or the **Deccan Plateau**, which are less fertile compared to the alluvial soils of the Northern Plains.
 
• The Northern Plains are known for their **high fertility** due to alluvial deposits, making them highly productive for farming.
